description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §2.13, §5.10, decision 27): who walks the Stonehold Highlands' roads while the giant is there - at most two at once, one every 60-120 s, 120-220 m away, out of view, on a road node; kill XP for each entry's first three spawns only. Rival giant scouts and troll packs for a giant of stage 5 and up; with Harrok slain his clan's giants roam the highlands, hostile for good. The plan's toll-rider siege train (stage 6) waits for engines that can travel with a copy (docs/systems/P36.md).
